newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia to offer A$700 mln in T-bonds.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia to offer A$700 mln in T-bonds.

text.p: The Treasury will offer a total of A$700 million in Treasury bonds through a tender on Tuesday, the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) said.
The offering will comprise A$400 million of 7.0 percent bonds maturing in April 2000 and A$300 million of 6.75 percent bonds maturing in November 2006.
The bank said bids would be received until 12.45 pm. (0145 GMT) on Tuesday and results will be announced at 2.00 p.m. (0300 GMT). Settlement date is March 13.
